title: processkit migrate data
description: The 'data' of processkit migrate --json (v0-migration@v1 PK-MIG-022). The plan is carried in the envelope's 'plan' (cli@v1 schemas/plan.schema.json), the written files in 'changes', and manual actions in 'diagnostics' (PK-MIG-020).

mode.description: v0: processkit migrate --from v0. content-api: processkit migrate without --from.

v0Release.description: install.processkit_version of context/.processkit-provenance.toml, or null when the marker is absent or mode is content-api.

items.description: One entry per recognized v0 source (or per rewritten item in mode content-api), sorted by the first source path in ascending Unicode code point order.

untouched.description: Untouched v0 items (files below context/ with a string metadata.id that are not converted sources) per v0 kind, sorted by kind. Empty in mode content-api.

sourceKind.description: v0 kind of the source; Skill for a v0 skill.

sourceId.description: metadata.id of the v0 source (metadata.processkit.id for a skill).

sourcePaths.description: Every v0 file of the source, sorted.

targetName.description: v1 metadata.name of the converted item, or null when it could not be derived.

targetPaths.description: Every file of the converted item, sorted.

status.description: convertible: no manual action for this source. blocked: at least one manual action names one of its source paths.

fields.description: Per-run preservation report of the item (PK-MIG-026): one entry per source field and target, sorted by source, then target.

source.description: JSON pointer into the v0 front matter, 'body' for the Markdown body, or a path relative to the skill directory for a kept file.

target.description: mapped: JSON pointer into the converted item's front matter or JSON, or 'body'. annotated: the annotation key. kept: the target path. supplement: null.
